global-vendetta.notes: ARC/other printings are usable only when the same card name has a legal-set printing; preview-only future sets are excluded.

taiwan-set1-banned.label: Taiwan — Set 1 pool with global bans
taiwan-set1-banned.notes: Regional physical pool is OGN + OGS. The applicable Constructed ban list is layered on top.

global-vendetta-2026-10-22.label: Global Standard - Vendetta, calibration snapshot
global-vendetta-2026-10-22.notes: The environment P4 calibrates against: the last day of the Vendetta pool before Radiance (2026-10-23). It is not stale after that date and never becomes stale - it is the historical record the official matchup data for this pool describes. status is scheduled_freeze, not frozen: global-vendetta is still live, and a ban-list change before 2026-10-22 would still move this content. On the freeze date the status becomes frozen and content_hash is filled with the digest of legal_set_ids plus the ban list in force; after that the entry is immutable and a change to it is a gate failure, not an update.
